data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'n-s-y' which means 'to ask, to seek, to be generous'. In Islamic history, Onays is the name of a noble companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). The name Onays carries the meaning “Graceful, Generous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Onays usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, generous and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Onays total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
